Coordinating work, checking preconditions and mapping to DTOs are all application-layer jobs. The file has no persistence code, no transport or HTTP handling, and no framework code. Neither is a clear case of another layer's job (persistence, transport or framework) living in this file. Both are reasonable design choices inside a use case, so I don't count them as layer violations.
